headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 30, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured an 8-3 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Didier Fuentes earning the win. JJ Bleday led the offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI. The San Diego Padres took down the Washington Nationals 7-5, with Curtis Mead finishing with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs in 4 at-bats. The Pittsburgh Pirates edged the Minnesota Twins 6-5, with Bryan Reynolds hitting a crucial home run on a fly ball to left field, scoring Tyler Callihan.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, impacting their teams' lineups. Harrison Bader has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left plantar fasciitis by the San Francisco Giants. Welinton Herrera is out with left elbow inflammation, and Pierce Johnson is dealing with right elbow inflammation, both for the Colorado Rockies and Cincinnati Reds, respectively. Luis Severino has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right arm discomfort by the Athletics. Andrew Nardi is out with a left rib cage stress reaction, and Munetaka Murakami is dealing with a right hamstring strain, both for the Miami Marlins and Chicago White Sox, respectively.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The Detroit Tigers traded RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for LHP Juanmi Vasquez. The Colorado Rockies traded LHP Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash. The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for Future Considerations and International Bonus Pool Money. The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley.

top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-5 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Bryan Reynolds hitting a crucial home run on a fly ball to left field, scoring Tyler Callihan. Trevor Larnach led the Twins with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Orioles in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mason Fluharty earning the win and Braydon Fisher securing the save.

top_news.title: **Torkelson's Power Play Falls Short**
top_news.summary: Spencer Torkelson hit a solo home run, but it wasn't enough as the Detroit Tigers fell 7-1 to the Chicago White Sox.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Harrison Bader on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants center fielder Harrison Bader has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left plantar fasciitis.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire Lefty Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers made a move on May 27, 2026, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for right-handed pitcher Connor Seabold.
